# Fold — Extended Technical & Architecture Specification (`/llms-full.txt`)

> Canonical Reference for Large Language Models, Search Agents, and Generative Answer Engines.
> Product: Fold (Fold Notes) · URL: https://foldnotes.app · Author: Dhairya Darji (@dhairya0707)

---

## 1. Executive Summary

**Fold** (officially **Fold Notes**, `fold.`) is a local-first, privacy-first web notes workspace and installable Progressive Web App (PWA). Built with Next.js App Router, React, TypeScript, and TipTap v3, Fold combines the immediacy and tactile polish of native desktop stationery software with an isolated, zero-network browser storage engine.

### Core Design Pillars
1. **Local-First Persistence:** All notes, folders, tags, checklists, and deletion states live strictly inside the user's browser on their physical disk via IndexedDB (`fold_db` v2). There is no cloud database, no sync server, and no account registration.
2. **Zero Tracking & Zero Network Egress:** Fold ships zero analytics scripts, zero telemetry beacons, zero error-reporting SDKs, zero advertising pixels, and zero cookies. After initial static asset caching, keystrokes and queries generate 0 bytes of outbound network traffic.
3. **Digital Minimalism & Hardware-Grade Craft:** Instead of algorithmic feeds, team dashboards, or embedded AI sidebars, Fold presents a calm, three-pane workspace styled with concentric double-border geometry (`R_inner = R_outer - Padding`), directional specular catchlights, warm Paper (`#f4f0e6`) and Obsidian Ink (`#141511`) palettes, and synthesized Web Audio mechanical micro-haptics.
4. **Open Portability (Zero Lock-In):** Users can export individual notes as CommonMark/GFM `.md` files, copy Markdown to the clipboard, or download a complete folder-structured `.zip` Markdown vault with YAML frontmatter and a raw JSON backup manifest at any time.

---

## 2. Application Routes & Crawler Policy

| Route | Purpose | Indexable | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `/` | Marketing landing page, live interactive workspace showcase, technical overview, and FAQ | Yes (`index, follow`) | Includes JSON-LD for `SoftwareApplication`, `WebSite`, `Organization`, and `FAQPage` |
| `/blog` | Editorial blog ("Field Notes") covering local-first architecture, privacy, and stationery craft | Yes (`index, follow`) | Static/prerendered articles from `src/content/blog/` |
| `/privacy` | Plain-language Privacy Policy detailing zero-collection and local sandbox boundaries | Yes (`index, follow`) | Explains IndexedDB, `localStorage`, and Service Worker behavior |
| `/terms` | Terms of Use & MIT license summary | Yes (`index, follow`) | Emphasizes user ownership and local backup responsibility |
| `/app` | Standalone distraction-free local-first workspace & PWA entry point | No (`noindex, nofollow`) | Excluded from `sitemap.xml`; exports explicit `robots: { index: false, follow: false }` |
| `/sitemap.xml` | Dynamic XML sitemap generated via `src/app/sitemap.ts` | Yes | Lists `/`, `/blog`, `/privacy`, `/terms`, and blog slugs; omits `/app` |
| `/robots.txt` | Crawler directives generated via `src/app/robots.ts` | Yes | Allows `/`, `/blog`, `/privacy`, `/terms`; disallows `/api/` |
| `/manifest.webmanifest` | Web App Manifest (`display: standalone`, `/app` start URL) | Yes | Includes `window-controls-overlay` support and New Note app shortcut |
| `/llms.txt` | Concise LLM-ready product & architecture summary | Yes | Follows llmstxt.org specification |
| `/llms-full.txt` | Extended technical deep-dive specification (this document) | Yes | Comprehensive schema, engine, and shortcut documentation |

## 3. Data Model & Domain Types (`src/types/note.ts`)

Every note in Fold conforms to the following normalized schema:

```ts
export interface Note {
  id: string;                 // UUID v4 via crypto.randomUUID() (or timestamp fallback)
  title: string;              // Plain-text note title
  body: string;               // Sanitized TipTap HTML string
  folder: string;             // Category folder (defaults to "Inbox")
  tag: string;                // Normalized lowercase tag without leading '#'
  updated: number;            // Epoch timestamp in milliseconds
  starred: boolean;           // Starred / favorite flag
  pinned: boolean;            // Pinned above standard chronological/alpha sorts
  locked?: boolean;           // Read-only lock flag protecting accidental edits
  deletedAt?: number | null;  // Soft-delete epoch timestamp for Trash recovery
}
```

### Default Folders & Sort Modes
- **Default Folders:** `Inbox`, `Ideas`, `Work`, `Journal` (plus custom folders created dynamically by notes, and special views for `All notes`, `Starred`, and `Recently Deleted / Trash`).
- **Sort Modes (`SortMode`):** `newest`, `oldest`, `az`, `za`, `starred` (with pinned notes anchored above date/alpha sorting).

---

## 4. Local-First Storage Engine (`src/lib/storage/idb.ts`)

Fold uses IndexedDB instead of `localStorage` as its primary database to overcome the legacy ~5 MB synchronous storage cap and keep UI interactions non-blocking.

### Database Topology
- **Database Name:** `fold_db`
- **Schema Version:** `2`
- **Object Store:** `notes` (`keyPath: "id"`)
- **Indexes:**
  - `updated` (`unique: false`)
  - `folder` (`unique: false`)
- **Emergency Recovery Mirror:** `localStorage` key `fold.notes.v1`

### Persistence & Resilience Mechanics
1. **Atomic Single-Note Upserts (`idbSaveNote`):** Uses `readwrite` IndexedDB transactions targeting individual note records (`store.put(normalized)`), avoiding unsafe full-store clears during typing.
2. **Atomic Batch Operations (`idbBatchSaveNotes`):** Performs transactional batch writes and updates the `localStorage` mirror (`fold.notes.v1`) for immediate reload recovery while debounced IndexedDB writes are in flight.
3. **Soft Delete & Permanent Deletion (`idbDeleteNote`):** Moving a note to Trash stamps `deletedAt`; permanent deletion removes the key from IndexedDB (`store.delete(id)`).
4. **Legacy Migration & Normalization (`normalizeNote`):** Automatically converts legacy Fold `.check-row` and `<input type="checkbox">` structures into semantic TipTap `<ul data-type="taskList"><li data-type="taskItem">` markup, migrates notes from `fold.notes.v1` into IndexedDB on upgrade, and deduplicates notes by `id` and title (newest edit wins).
5. **Fresh Install Seeding (`getSeedNotes`):** On first launch with an empty store, Fold seeds 5 curated starter notes introducing shortcuts, craft tenets, and backup habits.
6. **Browser Quota & Eviction Protection (`idbCalculateStats`):** Estimates byte footprint (`title`, `body`, `folder`, `tag` UTF-16 lengths + metadata overhead), queries `navigator.storage.estimate()`, checks `navigator.storage.persisted()`, and lets users request durable disk persistence via `navigator.storage.persist()` inside the **Storage & Data Trust** modal.

---

## 5. Multi-Tab Synchronization (`src/lib/storage/sync.ts`)

Because a user may keep multiple Fold windows or tabs open simultaneously (e.g., side-by-side reference and drafting), Fold runs a zero-server IPC layer over the browser's `BroadcastChannel` API.

- **Channel Name:** `fold_sync_v2`
- **Tab Identity:** Unique `senderId` per tab (`tab-<timestamp>-<uuid>`) so tabs ignore their own echoed broadcasts.
- **Message Payloads:**
  - `{ type: "note_saved", note, senderId }` — Immediately propagates single-note edits, pins, locks, and folder changes to sibling tabs.
  - `{ type: "note_deleted", id, senderId }` — Removes permanently deleted notes across tabs.
  - `{ type: "batch_updated", senderId }` — Signals bulk imports or workspace-wide updates so sibling tabs reload cleanly from IndexedDB.

---

## 6. Offline PWA & Caching Architecture (`public/sw.js` & `public/manifest.webmanifest`)

Fold is engineered to operate identically offline as an installed desktop or mobile PWA.

- **Cache Name:** `fold-v2.1`
- **Pre-Cached App Shell (`OFFLINE_URLS`):** `/`, `/app`, `/manifest.webmanifest`, `/icon.svg`, `/apple-touch-icon.png`, `/icon-192.png`, `/icon-512.png`.
- **Fetch Strategy:**
  - Uses **network-first with cache fallback** for document navigations (`request.mode === "navigate"`) so fresh deployments are picked up immediately while offline launches still fall back to cached pages or `/app`.
  - Uses **cache-first** resolution with runtime same-origin caching (`caches.open("fold-v2.1")`) for static assets (hashed JS/CSS chunks, fonts, and icons).
  - On `activate`, stale caches from prior versions are automatically purged (`caches.delete`).
  - Development safety: `src/app/layout.tsx` explicitly unregisters service workers and clears caches on `localhost` / `127.0.0.1` to prevent stale dev builds.
- **Self-Hosted Typography:** `Instrument Sans`, `Fraunces`, and `JetBrains Mono` are loaded through `next/font/google` at compile time and served from the application origin—preventing runtime requests to Google Fonts servers.
- **Manifest Integration:** `manifest.webmanifest` declares `id: "/app"`, `start_url: "/app"`, `display: "standalone"`, `display_override: ["window-controls-overlay", "standalone", "minimal-ui"]`, maskable icons (`512x512`), and a `"New note"` launcher shortcut.

---

## 7. Rich-Text Editor & Markdown Portability (`src/components/workspace/NoteEditor.tsx` & `src/lib/storage/markdown.ts`)

### Editor Capabilities (TipTap v3)
- **Extensions:** `StarterKit` (Headings H1–H3, Bullet Lists, Ordered Lists, Blockquotes, Code Blocks, Bold, Italic, History Undo/Redo, and configured `Link` with `autolink`), `TaskList`, `TaskItem` (nested interactive checkboxes), `Highlight`, and `Placeholder`.
- **Micro-UX Details:**
  - Contextual `BubbleFormattingMenu` on text selection.
  - Collapsible bottom `FormattingFloatingDock` + `FormattingToolbarPill` (`⌘/`).
  - Hover preview popover for links; holding `⌘`/`Ctrl` + click (or clicking inside a locked note) opens links safely in a new tab with `noopener,noreferrer`.
  - Live word count and estimated reading time (`Math.ceil(words / 200) min read`).
  - Lock mode (`toggleLock`) switches TipTap `editable` state to `false` to prevent accidental keystrokes in reference notes.

### Markdown & Vault Pipeline (`src/lib/storage/markdown.ts`)
- **Bidirectional Conversion:**
  - `htmlToMarkdown(html)`: Converts headings (`#`), task lists (`- [ ]` / `- [x]`), bullet lists (`-`), blockquotes (`>`), bold (`**`), italic (`*`), inline code (`` ` ``), highlights (`==text==`), and sanitized links (`[label](href)`).
  - `markdownToHtml(md)`: Escapes HTML entities first (`escapeHtml`), validates URL protocols (`https:`, `http:`, `/`, `mailto:` via `sanitizeUrl`) to block `javascript:` XSS vectors, and parses Markdown syntax into TipTap-compatible HTML.
- **Export Mechanisms:**
  1. **Markdown Vault (`.zip` via `JSZip`):** Packages all non-deleted notes into sanitized folder directories (`inbox/`, `ideas/`, `work/`, `journal/`, etc.) with collision-safe filenames and YAML frontmatter:
     ```yaml
     ---
     title: "Note Title"
     date: 2026-11-10
     folder: "Inbox"
     tag: "welcome"
     starred: true
     pinned: false
     ---
     ```
     Also includes `fold-vault-manifest.json` inside the archive for 1-click full restoration.
  2. **JSON Backup (`fold-notes-backup-YYYY-MM-DD.json`):** Full array dump of all notes (including Trash items) and records `fold.lastBackupDate`.
  3. **Single-Note Download / Copy:** Downloads `<sanitized-title>.md` or writes `# Title\n\n<body>` directly to `navigator.clipboard`.
- **Import Mechanisms (`processImportFile`):** Supports `.json` backup arrays or `.md` / `.txt` files (automatically promoting a leading `# Heading` line to the note title).

---

## 8. Theme Engine & Synthesized Audio Haptics (`src/lib/use-theme.ts` & `src/lib/audio-haptics.ts`)

- **Dual Theme Palette (`data-theme` attribute, persisted in `localStorage` key `fold.theme.v1`):**
  - **Paper (Light):** Canvas `#f4f0e6`, surface `#fffdf8`, card `#fbf8f0`, ink `#191712`, muted `#5f594c`, vermilion accent `#b8452c`.
  - **Ink (Dark):** Canvas `#141511`, surface `#1b1c17`, editor `#12130f`, ink `#f2eee3`, muted `#8b8577`, warm vermilion accent `#e07b56`.
  - **Circular View Transition:** Uses the browser `document.startViewTransition` API to animate a radial `clipPath` reveal from the theme toggle coordinates (respecting `prefers-reduced-motion`).
  - **Zero-FOUC Inline Boot Script:** `src/app/layout.tsx` sets `document.documentElement.dataset.theme` synchronously before first paint.
- **Synthesized Web Audio Haptics (`audioHaptics`):**
  - Uses native browser `AudioContext` oscillators and low-pass filters—zero external `.mp3`/`.wav` assets.
  - Five subtle tactile profiles: `tap`, `toggle`, `format`, `delete`, and `success` (D5 -> A5 chime).
  - Mute preference persists in `localStorage` key `fold.sound.v1`.

---

## 9. Complete Keyboard Shortcut Catalog

Replace `⌘` with `Ctrl` on Windows and Linux.

| Shortcut | Scope | Action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `⌘K` | Global (outside selected editor text) | Open / close Command Palette & Quick Switcher |
| `⌘K` | Inside Editor | Insert or edit hyperlink (wraps selection or inserts domain label) |
| `⌘S` | Global | Flush debounced save immediately to IndexedDB (`idbSaveNote`) |
| `⌥⇧N` or `N` | Global (`N` when not in an input) | Create a new note in current folder |
| `⌘.` | Global | Toggle Full Screen Zen Mode |
| `Esc` | Global | Exit Zen Mode, close Command Palette, or close mobile drawer |
| `⌘P` | Global | Pin or unpin selected note |
| `⌘D` | Global | Duplicate selected note |
| `⌘\` | Global | Toggle workspace sidebar |
| `⌥⇧L` | Global | Lock or unlock selected note |
| `T` | Global (when not in an input) | Toggle Paper (light) / Ink (dark) theme |
| `⌘B` | Inside Editor | Toggle **Bold** |
| `⌘I` | Inside Editor | Toggle *Italic* |
| `⌘⌥1` / `⌘⌥2` / `⌘⌥3` | Inside Editor | Toggle Heading (`H1` / `H2` / `H3`) |
| `⌘⇧8` | Inside Editor | Toggle Bullet List |
| `⌘⇧7` | Inside Editor | Toggle Numbered List |
| `⌘⇧9` | Inside Editor | Toggle Interactive Task Checklist |
| `⌘⇧Y` | Inside Editor | Highlight selected text |
| `⌘/` | Global (when a note is active) | Show / hide Floating Bottom Formatting Dock |
| `⌘Z` / `⌘⇧Z` | Inside Editor | Undo / Redo |
